text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Why does this festering sorrow seep through...!
Curse it all!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...!
My Ruin-Beckoning Dropkick didn't work?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: If you intend to reject me, I'll just pry you open!! My spear can shatter even the unbreakable!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet failed to kick down the fence.
It seems fatigue from consecutive races has caught up.
It might be best to reconsider our upcoming schedule.
